title: Characterizing the Performance of Parallel Data-Compression Algorithms across Compilers and GPUs
problem: Compiler choice and GPU platform significantly affect data compression performance; unclear which combinations are optimal
motivation: Data compression critical for HPC; different compilers produce different performance characteristics requiring systematic study
method: Comprehensive empirical evaluation of 107,632 compression algorithms across compilers (NVCC, Clang, HIPCC) and platforms (NVIDIA, AMD)
key_novelty: Large-scale empirical characterization showing compiler-hardware interaction effects on compression
contributions: Identifies compiler-specific performance patterns (Clang slow compression, fast decompression)
limitations: Empirical characterization; lacks root-cause analysis of performance differences
